extraction.Name: Jesse Peters
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to R. C. Spinning for $1700 then sold for $2000 allottee receiving but $65.00 for the land.
extraction.Buyer: Land sold for $2000 which the allottee thinks was $1000 below market value.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It seems that the mortgage prevented him from receiving more money for the land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Bad eyesight. No property and no money accumulated. Wife and two children dependent upon him. Date and manner of delivery of patent: Jan. 1918, Agency Office. It is believed that the allottee did not receive full value for his land. Notarized November 26, 1928; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929. Signed with x mark. | Split from bundled record part12_questionnaire_005 on 2026-04-27. Bundled extraction returned two records as a list; promoted to standalone records. Companion record: part12_questionnaire_005a (Warren Real Rider).

testimony.subject: Status of fee patent and allotted land, Allotment No. 728
testimony.key_claims: Patent received at Agency Office in January 1918, receipted with protest. Does not remember if filed for record. Land mortgaged to R. C. Spinning for $1700 then sold for $2000; allottee received only $55.00. Land sold for $2000 which allottee believes was $1000 below market value. Mortgage not released or foreclosed. Age 56, bad eyesight, no property and no money accumulated. No income from inherited land; shares in Pawnee annuity. Wife and two children dependent. Believed he did not receive full value; mortgage prevented receiving more money.
